scope: Driver trip history and trip details redesign

research.pattern: Date/status history, selecting a trip for earnings details; cancellation does not imply zero compensation.
Separate trip receipts from aggregate earnings overview.
Separate history from broader earnings goals/payout functionality.

implemented: Brand navy/blue/yellow with dark money text on white, no low-contrast yellow amounts.
Compact store/reference/status/entitlement/time/quantity cards, date grouping includes year and uses local end time.
Server-side date and terminal-state filters with cursor continuation and deduplication; late filter responses/session replacement rejected.
Single-order trip detail read authenticates owner, excludes internal finance allocations and phone numbers.
Confirmed financial driver entitlement replaces customer delivery tariff in history; Yalla2750 vs tariff1500.

Read-only trip details: base/tip/total, saved stop coordinates/addresses and actual timestamps, accepted route estimate explicitly labeled, COD cash/retained amount/settled collateral/extra wallet credit.
Saved delivery photos accessible in read-only mode; existing cash review and actual-return continuation preserved as explicit actions.
Returned terminal orders are visible; unknown states and missing earnings are not labeled completed/zero.
limits: One order per trip in current data model; no invented multi-stop shopping or mutable-tip policies.
Historical map shows stored pickup/destination markers only; no invented GPS road trace or newly computed route presented as historical.
Distance is accepted route estimate; elapsed duration includes waiting from acceptance until recorded completion.
Legacy missing earnings and unproven cancelled/returned compensation are unavailable, never replaced by customer fees or assumed zero.

Orders table still has no driver chronology index: bounded scans/cursors preserved; client sorts loaded rows. Current verified driver history all15 rows fit one page. No partial-page aggregate earnings shown.
No financial calculations, balance changes, order transitions, IAM/environment changes or other financial-function redeployment.

verification.analyzer: No errors/warnings; style/legacy print infos only
verification.installed: Profile250 successfully installed on existing test iPhone; app launch requested
